propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register due to invalid SKILL.md frontmatter: oversized descriptions and unquoted colons breaking YAML parse.

The skill descriptions exceed or violate the Agent Skills spec: rebar-implement has 1327 chars, rebar-janitor has 1068 chars (both over 1024-char cap), and rebar-debug contains unquoted ': ' that breaks plain scalar parsing.
A new deterministic CI lint check (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) validates all SKILL.md files for parseable YAML frontmatter, non-empty description <= 1024 chars, and conformant name format.
SKILL.md frontmatters are rewritten to use YAML folded block scalars (description: >-) and descriptions are trimmed to <= 1024 chars while preserving each skill's invocation trigger.
The lint check is wired into make lint target and paired with unit tests covering valid skills, over-cap descriptions, empty descriptions, unparseable YAML, and invalid name formats.
